reuse.why: The tree already has getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) returning exactly this value (0 for missing, the number, or the range end furthest from zero via getRangeAmount), and the diff ignores it.

duplication.why: getExpectedAmount re-implements the missing/number/range dispatch and the furthest-from-zero choice that getScheduledAmount and getRangeAmount already define.

placement.why: Mapping the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is the right layer, but the amount rule itself is defined privately in api-models.ts instead of coming from the shared schedules module.

scope.why: Focused on the new field, though it widens toExternal's return type to a list-specific type for every user of the model.

maintainability.why: A second private definition of the expected amount will drift from getScheduledAmount the next time the worst-case rule changes, so API scripts would disagree with the app.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getExpectedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts instead of calling getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedAmount in server/api-models.ts restates getScheduledAmount/getRangeAmount under a new name and with an inlined comparison rather than calling them.
